title: TurnCompleted
description: A turn finished, from the SDK's `result`. It is what closes the turn in the UI and what carries its cost.

promptedBy.description: Who sent the prompt this turn answered.

usage.description: Token counts as the SDK reports them. An open map on purpose — the SDK adds fields to it, and a closed shape here would drop them.

costUsd.description: Cost of the turn, as a decimal string. A string and not a number because money through a float is money that rounds where nobody looked.
